messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on the nearest weekday when it falls on a weekend), thereby extending the weekend to three consecutive days.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | Jan 1 – 3 |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, PE) | Monday Feb 20 | – | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | Apr 7 – 9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | May 20 – 22 |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | Jul 1 – 3 |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | Sep 2 – 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | Oct 7 – 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | Nov 11 – 13 |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | – | Dec 23 – 25 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | Dec 24 – 26 |

**Notes**

* **Family Day** is observed in several provinces (British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Prince Edward Island).  
* **Canada Day** falls on a Saturday in 2023, so the holiday is observed on Monday July 3, creating a three‑day weekend from July 1 – 3.  
* **Remembrance Day** falls on a Saturday, so the observed day is Monday Nov 13, giving a long weekend from Nov 11 – 13.  
* **Christmas** and **Boxing Day** together create a long weekend from Dec 23 – 26.

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the same information for other years or additional details (e.g., province‑specific holidays), let me know!
